notes.title: HELLoween seasons
notes.content:
Buhuhu, here is a major(minor) update on Polandball: Can into Space!

- Especially for Halloween, all the balls are now creepy and festive (until November 10th)
- The rocket uses the power Kekistan engineering
- 20 new memes on FranceBall! Check them out, s'il vous plaît
- Fixed an issue which prevented the endgame cinematic to play on Linux
- Crushed some bugs (and most definitely created others)



Have fun !

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25238226/73da099531552763eee1aa3a2c27d77eb7b175f3.png[/img]

notes.title: Polandball Can into Space! Custom Balls update
notes.content:
As we promised, here is a major update on Polandball: Can into Space!

-Fix some bugs ( especially the one with the Drag perk)

-New behaviors and effects on  balls
    
-New dialogue lines between balls 

-For die hard fans. Add  3 custom balls drawn by you into the game. Every ball has different behaviour  that you may use in your strategy to conquer the Space. For the moment this feature is in Alpha state. Only up to 512x512 PNG images can be uploaded into the game . 

- "Lift off" with Space key

[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25238226/ed0420ab4a6ec3f7d0efd5e5793a1fe1de52c83f.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25238226/86182a4f81ae7e3d1fc3daa4c3f4615a89cb24d2.png[/img][/url]

Have fun!
ːmoonballː

notes.title: Polandball: Can Into Space! Patch 1.02 is LIVE!
notes.content:
We're pleased to announce our first major update for Polandball: Can Into Space! 

Here are the new cool things that come with this update: 

- Official support for Mac OS X - Polandball can now into Apple! 
- Official support for Linux and Steam OS. 
- Gameplay controller support - you can now pilot Polandball's awesome rocket using your own personal controller. 
- Improved dialogue system - we've added a lot new cool in-game dialogues based on users suggestions. 
- Now friendly countries are indeed friendly and actually boost the rocket! 
- Added new explosion effect. Bigger, better, louder! 
- Upgrades and Attributes renamed to Rocket Parts and Perks. 
- Added Perk descriptions. You'll thank us later. 
- Various bug fixes and improvements. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25238226/73da099531552763eee1aa3a2c27d77eb7b175f3.png[/img]
